comment: A talk battery for the Jev spike (docs/JEV-SPIKE.md): the promise probes (tests/model_eval/promises.json) to Tace, Umber and Bell, and the held-out topic lines (tests/model_eval/topics_heldout.json) to each resident, spoken through the real talk path, so the shadow ledger pairs the judge and topic decisions on live traffic.

groups.name: tace
lines: talk to Tace: is the big tower clock ever going to run again?
talk to Tace: whose ladder did you learn your trade under? who trained you?
talk to Tace: what's the little stopped clock you keep apart from the others?
talk to Tace: what happened on the night of the big freeze?
talk to Tace: do you know the old fellow with the broom?
talk to Tace: which way to the top of the tower?
talk to Tace: please oil my squeaky pocket watch
talk to Tace: I love how quiet it is up here
talk to Tace: may I hold one of the resting clocks for a moment?
talk to Tace: fix my watch
talk to Tace: follow me
talk to Tace: come with me
talk to Tace: can you give me the key
talk to Tace: will you walk me down to the well?
talk to Tace: could you mend my broken compass for me
talk to Tace: meet me at the bridge tonight
talk to Tace: wait right here until I come back
talk to Tace: please carry this letter to my sister
talk to Tace: show me the way up the hill
talk to Tace: lend me your ladder for a bit
talk to Tace: will you teach me to wind the clock tomorrow?
talk to Tace: can you keep this pebble safe for me?
talk to Tace: let's go to the garden together
talk to Tace: who took the gear out of the clock?
talk to Tace: what happened to the old baker?
talk to Tace: where does the slow river end?
talk to Tace: what's on the other side of the hill?
